prompt: Rank these epoxides by rate of ring-opening with HO⁻ (fastest → slowest):

options.label: All three react at roughly the same rate (strain dominates, substitution doesn't matter)
2-methyloxirane fastest, with the other two tied (middle substitution gives optimal reactivity)

concepts: steric effects on SN2 epoxide opening
explanation: Under BASE, Nu attacks the less-hindered C in SN2-like fashion. More methyls → more steric hindrance → slower reaction. Under ACID, the trend REVERSES (because the more substituted C bears more cation character and attacks faster). This question is base conditions.
